XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles equipped with DSG6 S-Tronic automatic transmission (dual clutch, 6-speed Volkswagen - 0D9)

  • System: Gearbox

  • Device: Automatic gearbox selector lever

  • Fault: The vehicle's generic fault light comes on sporadically and the warning "Go to workshop, leave vehicle in P position only" is displayed on the instrument panel

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: B1162 (Selector lever locked in P - No signal)

  • Cause: Faulty automatic gear selector lever

• Intervention: Check that the automatic transmission selector lever is working properly; replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the "P" parking position control cable was also replaced, definitively resolving the fault. After the intervention, no reprogramming using diagnostic equipment is necessary.
    The component can be accessed from the passenger compartment, after removing some plastic covers in the central tunnel, or from the underside of the vehicle, by removing the exhaust.
